question: Cuales son los clientes con el mayor potencial de abandono?
generated_sql:
WITH latest_run AS (
  SELECT run_id, MAX(scored_at) AS max_scored_at
  FROM classic_stable_douglas_s_catalog.quetzal_telecom.gold_churn_graph_predictions
  WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY run_id
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY max_scored_at DESC, run_id DESC) = 1
), ranked_customers AS (
  SELECT
    CONCAT('***', RIGHT(customer_id, 4)) AS cliente_mascarado,
    risk_tier,
    baseline_churn_probability,
    influenced_revenue_usd,
    influence_score,
    contagion_risk_score,
    high_risk_neighbour_pct,
    recommended_action,
    scored_at,
    RANK() OVER (
      ORDER BY baseline_churn_probability DESC, influenced_revenue_usd DESC, influence_score DESC, contagion_risk_score DESC
    ) AS risk_rank
  FROM classic_stable_douglas_s_catalog.quetzal_telecom.gold_churn_graph_predictions
  WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
    AND baseline_churn_probability IS NOT NULL
    AND influenced_revenue_usd IS NOT NULL
    AND influence_score IS NOT NULL
    AND contagion_risk_score IS NOT NULL
    AND run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM latest_run)
)
SELECT
  cliente_mascarado,
  risk_tier,
  baseline_churn_probability,
  influenced_revenue_usd,
  influence_score,
  contagion_risk_score,
  high_risk_neighbour_pct,
  recommended_action,
  scored_at,
  risk_rank
FROM ranked_customers
WHERE risk_rank <= 10
ORDER BY risk_rank, baseline_churn_probability DESC, influenced_revenue_usd DESC, influence_score DESC, contagion_risk_score DESC
